Let \(n\) be an odd integer with \(n^2\) not divisible by \(9\), so \(3\nmid n\).

- Since \(n\) is odd, \(n^2 \equiv 1 \pmod 8\).
- Since \(3\nmid n\), \(n \equiv \pm1 \pmod 3\), so \(n^2 \equiv 1 \pmod 3\).

Because \(\gcd(8,3)=1\),

\[
n^2 \equiv 1 \pmod{24}.
\]

Thus, \(n^2-1\) is divisible by \(24\).

\[
\boxed{n^2-1 \equiv 0 \pmod{24}}
\]
